This thread was closed because the question was posted twice. The other thread titled 'Cable - Unable to access the IP Address COM3' is available in the relevant conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports difficulty connecting to a specified COM port while using [product_name] [version_no], receiving an error message that conflates COM port and IP address. The problem stems from unclear configuration options and confusing error feedback, which impedes effective troubleshooting.
